meaning: Received account statements and explicit transaction reports. Integer-cent identities are accounting checks, not clinical judgments, collectability estimates, realized savings or contract settlements.

reconciliation_contract.universe: For a transaction reconciliation, begin with every received transaction record in the inherited patient population and receipt cutoff. Claim/account summaries contain linked records only and cannot establish the absence of unlinked transactions.
reconciliation_contract.link: Keep the transaction record_id as the unique row key. Left-link explicit entity IDs; require matching subject/account for accepted attribution. Retain absent, ambiguous and conflicting links as separate unresolved categories.
reconciliation_contract.cohort_partition: Partition linked transactions by the requested entity cohort and retain transactions linked to another received cohort plus unlinked/invalid-link transactions. A service-date cohort does not authorize discarding older or undated cash posting records with unresolved service attribution.
reconciliation_contract.clocks: Keep transaction event and receipt clocks distinct. Keep unknown clocks explicit; never derive a missing event date from receipt date. Apply a posting-period filter only when the request actually specifies one.
reconciliation_contract.currency: Use explicit transaction currency or the registered same-subject/account currency binding. Missing or conflicting currency remains unknown. Never add currencies together or label unbound cents USD.
reconciliation_contract.closure: Verify that the disjoint categories contain every selected source record_id exactly once. Reconcile counts, known amounts and missing-amount counts per currency; retain negative allocations. Arithmetic ties alone do not establish source completeness.
reconciliation_contract.execution: Use the existing query_sql and compose_table primitives. A left composition retains the complete transaction base and makes unmatched entity links explicit; native measures preserve grain, domain, population and null policy. Do not request another model to calculate these identities.
